prediction_vs_result.prediction: Three, each read at every step and reported whole. (1) Specificity, the hypothesis's own, at the decision's row, stated for the raw pair of readings (added beside outgoing) and for the feature pair (through beside outgoing) separately: the median share over the steps where both readings of the pair have one is lower for the added (through) reading than for the outgoing one, the added (through) share is the lower at more than half of those steps, and the added (through) reading is resolved, wrong over successful, at more steps than the outgoing one. (2) Which merges: the shared history enters a row through what its attention merges add, so at the decision's row the feed-forward merges' added reading has the lower median share and the attention merges' the higher. (3) The decision's row against the rows before it, at which the five write the same token: the added (through) reading is resolved at more steps at the decision's row than at the mean row before it. Beside these, an expectation that is mine and no part of the hypothesis: the whole length of the through term, which is the error the conditional transformation target (fd601fa6) would charge a row at the original weights, does not part the kinds, because one row's increment against a mixture of other answers is mostly its own particulars, while its part along the builders' common increment does.
prediction_vs_result.would_weaken_it: Of (1): a share of the added (through) reading that is not below the outgoing one's in the median, successful controls at or over the wrong ones, no more steps resolved than the outgoing reading has, or a reading undetermined or unresolved at most steps. Any of these weakens the proposed replacement of the whole-state leftover by its added component as the request, in this construction (one reference of twenty-nine, the cohort's builders, five cases); it says nothing against a request measured another way, and nothing about whether an edit can repair. Of (2): an attention reading as specific as the feed-forward's, or more: then the shared history is not what attention adds here, and the reason given for (1) is wrong even if (1) holds. Of (3): rows before the decision resolved at as many steps as the decision's row: then the separation follows the question's number through every row and is not particular to the decision, and since the kinds and the losses are not apart in these five, (1) could then not be read as the decision's computation. Of my expectation: through lengths that part the kinds as well as the projection does; the whole increment would then be usable as a request without a direction.

result.1_specificity: Not met as declared, in the raw states and in the features alike: two of its three parts hold and the third does not. Raw states, the added reading beside the outgoing one: over the 83 steps where both have a share, the successful controls show 0.9310 of what the wrong controls show in the added reading and 0.9415 in the outgoing one (the medians), and the added share is the lower at 51 of them; the added reading is resolved, wrong over successful, at 40 of 104 determined steps and the outgoing one at 45 of 105 (the other way: 16 and 15). Joint features, the through reading beside the outgoing one: over the 81 steps where both have a share, the successful controls show 0.9285 of what the wrong controls show in the through reading and 0.9593 in the outgoing one (the medians), and the through share is the lower at 50 of them; the through reading is resolved, wrong over successful, at 34 of 105 determined steps and the outgoing one at 48 of 106 (the other way: 14 and 14). The share is lower by 0.0106 and 0.0308, and the proposed reading is resolved at fewer steps, not more (the whole state keeps a separation once it has it, and what a merge adds shows only where it is added: the declaration named this and kept the clause). What decides the matter is the size: the successful controls keep 0.9310 of the wrong controls' added reading and 0.9285 of their through reading. What the five have in common along the registered wrong answers' direction is in what the merges add as it is in the whole state. Two of the declaration's weakening observations are met: no more steps resolved than the outgoing reading has, and a reading unresolved at most steps (resolved at 40 of 104 and at 34 of 105). The scope document's own wording is "Comparable added components in the successful controls, no improvement beyond their variation/uncertainty, or undetermined correspondence weakens that proposed replacement": I read these shares as comparable components; that assessment is Astra's.
result.2_which_merges: Holds by the letter and does not carry the reason given for it. At the decision's row the feed-forward merges' raw added reading has a median share of 0.9500 and the attention merges' 0.9595: lower by 0.0095. In the features the order is the other way (through: feed-forward 0.9688, attention 0.9377). Resolved wrong over successful and the other way, of the raw added reading: attention 11 and 2 of 35; feedforward 16 and 7 of 35; a layer's last merge 13 and 7 of 35. A layer's last merge has the lowest median share, 0.9125. The reason declared, that the shared history enters a row through what its attention merges add and the feed-forward's part is the specific one, is not supported: over the layers where the kinds part (the tables beside), the attention merges and the feed-forward merges add the common part and the parting part in one proportion (0.877 and 0.877).
result.3_the_decisions_row_against_the_rows_bef: Holds for each of the four readings, with a limit. Steps resolved, wrong over successful, at the decision's row against the mean row before it, at which the five write the same token: raw added 40 against 14.26 (the other way 16 against 10.76; the most at a row before 42, and 1 of 149 rows before at or over the decision's); raw outgoing 45 against 13.36 (the other way 15 against 11.07; the most at a row before 54, and 4 of 149 rows before at or over the decision's); through 34 against 13.99 (the other way 14 against 11.57; the most at a row before 40, and 4 of 149 rows before at or over the decision's); joint outgoing 48 against 13.31 (the other way 14 against 11.36; the most at a row before 46, and 0 of 149 rows before at or over the decision's). The limit: by this count the decision's row is among the highest rows and not apart from them; single rows before it reach or pass it. Of two wrong and three successful controls in an order that had nothing to do with their kind, both wrong ones would lie over all three successful ones in one order of ten; the rows before the decision lie near that, each way.
result.the_expectation_about_the_length: Holds by the letter, weakly. The through term's whole length has both wrong controls longer than all three successful ones, beyond their bounds, at 22 steps and the other way at 17 (of 105 known); its part along the builders' common increment is resolved at 34 and the other way at 14. The successful controls' through term is 0.9989 as long as the wrong controls' in the median. At the rows before the decision the wrong controls' is the longer at 5.95 steps in the mean and the successful controls' at 26.19, which is what a length that follows the loss would show (the successful controls' losses are the greater), and at the decision's row the wrong controls' become the longer at 22. So the whole increment carries something of the decision too; it does not tell the kinds apart by its size.

what_this_changes.what_was_asked: Astra's question at d78e9545: does replacing the whole-state leftover by what the merges add, at the comparison held fixed, remove a part that right-going and wrong-going answers on one text have in common, so that the request built on it is specific?
what_this_changes.what_the_recordings_say: No. On five answers that write one text through one decision, the three that decide the right way show 0.9310 of what the two wrong ones show in what the merges add, along the registered wrong answers' common direction, and 0.9415 in the whole state. At the feed-forward merges all five stand at about half the registered wrong answers' own median reading of what is added (0.529, 0.546 for the wrong controls, 0.459, 0.453, 0.481 for the successful ones). So most of what the cohort's direction reads on these five does not follow the kind: it is common to the five. One candidate reason, not tested here: it is what this text has against the reference's texts.
what_this_changes.where_the_kinds_do_part: A part of it does tell the kinds apart, and the trace says where. At the decision's row, from layer 20 to layer 34, what the feed-forward merges add has both wrong controls over all three successful ones at every layer (15 in a row; no row before the decision has more than 9), and what the attention merges add at 11 of those 15 layers. Its size there: the successful controls show 0.877 of the wrong controls' reading. Before layer 20 at that row the successful controls show as much as the wrong ones or a little more, and no row before the decision has such a run. Read along the cohort's direction, on this text and for this decision, the wrong and the right computation run together until the row that decides and part there in the later layers, by about an eighth of the reading.
what_this_changes.for_the_correction_request_fables_readin: Three things for the request, each from five cases and one decision. (1) A request made of the cohort's whole difference at such a row, or of its added component, with the cohort's correct answers as the comparison, asks mostly for what right-going answers on the same text hold too: 0.9310 of it in the median, all of it before layer 20, 0.877 of it after. That is a candidate reason why solves built on the cohort's cells moved correct answers; no candidate model was read here, so it is not tested. (2) The conditional transformation target with this reference: its error at the original weights is the through term. With a reference made of other texts that error is as long for a right-going answer on the same text as for a wrong-going one (0.9989 in the median), and along the builders' common increment the successful controls show 0.9285 of the wrong controls'. Its size does not tell which rows need a move. Whether a reference on the same line removes that is what a same-line reading at the sign's row can say; it is the next reading to declare. (3) What parts the kinds has a place (the deciding row, the later layers, what the feed-forward and the attention merges add) and a size (about an eighth of the cohort's reading there). A request for this decision would be that part: the difference of the two kinds on one text, with nothing asked before the row that decides.
what_this_changes.what_it_does_not_change: merge-contributions-original's and same-prefix-135-original's results, verdicts and gaps. No number here is an edit strength, a matrix choice, a mask or a threshold, and nothing here says whether an edit repairs: no weight was solved and no model made. The proposed replacement is weakened in this construction (one reference of twenty-nine, the cohort's builders, five cases); a request measured on one path is not touched by it.
